pk.context: 1500 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

tell: A cannabinoid whose metabolite 7-COOH-CBD reaches about 40-fold the parent's AUC, with a half-life of 56 to 61 hours.

clues.text: A high-fat meal raises peak exposure 5-fold and AUC 4-fold. It is more than 94% protein bound and is excreted mainly in feces.
A crystalline solid of molecular weight 314.46 that is insoluble in water; no salt form is named.
Approved under an NDA as a 100 mg/mL oral solution, dosed twice daily.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in hypersensitivity to the drug or its ingredients; diarrhea and transaminase elevations are among the most common reactions.
Seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, Dravet syndrome or tuberous sclerosis complex, in patients aged 1 year and older.
Its anticonvulsant mechanism is unknown, and it does not appear to act through the classic receptors of its chemical family.
The generic name begins with C and has eleven letters.
